headline: United States GP: Friday practice underway at COTA as Antonelli defends 102-point lead
whyCareReason: Free Practice 1 and 2 open the race weekend at COTA. Antonelli leads Russell by 102 points.
teaser: Friday practice underway in Austin. FP1 and FP2 on track. Mercedes lead Ferrari by 134.
story: Track running commenced Friday, 23 October, for the 2026 United States Grand Prix at Circuit of the Americas in Austin, Texas. Teams took to the 5.513 km circuit for Free Practice 1 at 12:30 local time, followed by Free Practice 2 at 16:00, evaluating aerodynamic efficiency and tire wear across COTA's famous sweeping esses and long back straight. Championship leader Kimi Antonelli enters the weekend with 340 points and a 102-point advantage over Mercedes teammate George Russell (238). Mercedes lead Ferrari 578 to 444 in the constructors' standings. Saturday features Free Practice 3 and Qualifying ahead of Sunday's 56-lap Grand Prix.
stakes: The American triple-header opens in Austin with 102 points separating the top two drivers. Antonelli has his first mathematical shot at the title.
rivalryAngle: Teammates Antonelli and Russell take their title duel to the track in Austin.
funFacts: Friday practice sessions FP1 (12:30 local) and FP2 (16:00 local) underway at COTA.
Circuit: 5.513 km, 20 turns, 56 laps. Race start Sunday 15:00 local time.

keyPlayers.name: Kimi Antonelli
keyPlayers.hook: Leads the drivers' championship with 340 points, 102 ahead of Russell.

keyPlayers.name: George Russell
keyPlayers.hook: Second on 238 points, seeking to delay his teammate's title coronation.

keyPlayers.name: Max Verstappen
keyPlayers.hook: Third in line with 221 points following victory in Singapore.
